description: For one USCIS form (I-485 unless asked), the share of the sample's cases approved in every online receipt block (IOE and five digits, 100,000 numbers each), with a 95% margin, and the newest block where the sample saw an approval. Send near for the 10 blocks either side of one. From receipt numbers PERM Tracker checks on USCIS's Case Status page: an estimate, never a receipt number. One block's every status group is in the block endpoint. Example: {"form":"I-485","near":"IOE09366"}.

form.description: A USCIS form, like I-485, I-765 or I-130. I-485 when left out. Example: I-485.

near.description: A block, IOE and five digits: only the 10 blocks either side of it that hold the form. Example: IOE09366.

name: get_receipt_blocks

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: The share of one form's sampled cases approved, block by block, from receipt numbers checked on USCIS's Case Status page. Estimates with a 95% margin.

approvalsSeenUpTo.description: The newest block where the sample saw an approved case of this form, e.g. IOE09365. Null when it has seen none.

blocks.description: Every block where the sample counted the form, in block order, or the blocks near the one asked for.

items.description: One receipt block's approved share for the form. The one-block answer has every group.

approved.description: One status group's figure: the sampled count, the estimated share and its 95% margin.

count.description: Sampled cases in this status group.

estimated.description: The sample's estimate of how many of the form's cases here are in this group.

high.description: The high end of the 95% margin on that share, from 0 to 1.

low.description: The low end of the 95% margin on that share, from 0 to 1.

share.description: The estimated share of the form's cases here in this group, from 0 to 1.

block.description: The block: IOE and five digits, the first eight characters of an online receipt number. Each block is 100,000 numbers.

counted.description: Cases of this form the sample counted in the block.

casesInSample.description: Every case in the sample, all forms, online and paper. Null when it couldn't be read.

form.description: The form these figures are for, e.g. I-485.

forms.description: The forms with the most sampled cases, most first. Any of them can be asked for with form.

near.description: The block the list was asked to centre on, or null for every block.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Get approval shares by USCIS receipt block
